ingredients.name: firm potatoes
ingredients.original: 1 kg firm potatoes, peeled, cut into matchsticks

ingredients.name: Swedish-style anchovies (ansjovis, spiced sprats)
ingredients.original: 125 g Swedish-style anchovies (ansjovis, spiced sprats), tin, with brine

steps.text: Soften the onions in half the butter without browning.
Layer potatoes, onion and fillets in a buttered dish, starting and ending with potato.
steps.critical: Do not rinse the matchsticks; their starch is what thickens the cream.

steps.text: Pour over half the cream and the anchovy brine, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and dot with the rest of the butter. Bake.
Add the rest of the cream and the milk and bake until the potatoes are soft and the top golden.

notes.techniques: Matchstick potatoes cook through faster than slices and release starch that thickens the cream. Adding the cream in two goes stops it from boiling over.
notes.chemistry: Potato starch gelatinises in the hot cream, turning it into a sauce; browning on top comes from the Maillard reaction in milk proteins and breadcrumbs.
notes.spiceProfile: The spiced sprats bring salt, sweetness and hints of cinnamon, clove and sandalwood.
notes.variations: The smörgåsbord classic made with Swedish sweet-spiced sprats, not Mediterranean anchovies.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled, coarsely grated or in matchsticks
ingredients.original: 1 kg potatoes, peeled, coarsely grated or in matchsticks

ingredients.name: Swedish-style anchovies (ansjovis)
ingredients.original: 125 g Swedish-style anchovies (ansjovis), tin, with brine

steps.text: Soften leek and onion in the butter.
Layer potato, leek-onion mixture and anchovies in a dish.
Mix the cooking cream with the anchovy brine and pepper and pour over. Top with parmesan and bake until golden and tender.
steps.critical: Check the potatoes with a knife; the gratin is done only when they are fully soft.

notes.techniques: Leek gives a milder, sweeter allium layer and lighter cream keeps it less rich.
notes.chemistry: Lower-fat cream is more likely to split when boiled, but the potato starch helps hold it together.
notes.spiceProfile: Milder and greener, with leek sweetness and white pepper.
notes.variations: Lighter everyday version using leek and 15 % cream, with an optional parmesan crust instead of breadcrumbs.

ingredients.name: firm potatoes
ingredients.original: 1 kg firm potatoes, peeled, cut into matchsticks

ingredients.name: salted anchovy fillets in oil
ingredients.original: 40 g salted anchovy fillets in oil, chopped

steps.text: Soften the onions in half the butter. Stir in the anchovies, sugar and allspice until the anchovies melt.
Layer potatoes and the onion mixture in a buttered dish.
Pour over the cream, top with breadcrumbs and bake until soft and golden.
steps.critical: Use far fewer Mediterranean anchovies than Swedish ansjovis; they are much saltier.

notes.techniques: Melting the anchovies into the onions spreads their flavour evenly rather than in salty pockets.
notes.chemistry: Salt-cured anchovies are rich in glutamates and dissolve in warm butter, seasoning the whole gratin.
notes.spiceProfile: A pinch of sugar and allspice imitates the sweet spicing of Swedish sprats.
notes.variations: An adaptation for when Swedish spiced sprats are unavailable: saltier and more savoury, so less fish is used.
